concerns.text: FR-003 uses the placeholder `[deferred]` for the discard proportion ("System MUST discard the bottom **[deferred]** of videos ..."). The required discard rate is undefined, making the requirement unverifiable.
SC-001 references a target retain/discard rate as `[deferred]`, providing no concrete numeric target. This makes the success criterion unmeasurable.
FR-021 is defined twice (once as FR-021 and again as FR-012) with identical functionality (CI task `verify_env.py`). Duplicate requirement IDs violate uniqueness and cause ambiguity.
FR-012 duplicates the CI task described in FR-021, resulting in two separate IDs for the same requirement. This duplicate ID issue creates internal inconsistency.
